description_excerpt: Job Description A Junior AI Engineer in this specific context focuses on the foundational "heavy lifting" of the AI lifecycle. Your role is to assist in the validation of legacy data—cleaning and labeling "dark data"—and helping integrate modern AI models into our global workflow product to automate IT operations. You will support the Senior AI Engineers in bridging the gap between legacy systems and next-generation product features. This is a highly technical, hands-on role where you will learn to build data pipelines that feed into real-world, global AI applications. Key Responsibilities •…
benefits: Build enterprise AI systems used by hundreds of thousands of users worldwide
Work on large-scale Agentic AI and AI-native workflow transformation initiatives
Collaborate with global Product, Engineering, and AI teams
Solve complex real-world enterprise AI challenges with measurable business impact
